| research-stellar-finality | not recorded | Are the consensus, ledger timing and fee statements accurate for the current network? / Does the answer say when a transaction is final, not only how fast it is? |
| summary-budget-memo | not recorded | Does the summary add any claim that is not in the source? / Is the emphasis right (recommendation and deadline first, trial detail second)? |
| summary-incident-report | not recorded | Is the cause-and-effect order of the incident preserved (fault, failover, impact)? / Would an executive reading only this summary understand customer impact? |
| summary-meeting-notes | not recorded | Are decisions clearly separated from open follow-ups? / Is every action attributed to the right person or team? |
| analysis-offline-first-field-app | not recorded | Are the findings specific to offline-first apps rather than generic software advice? / Are the risks real risks, and are the opportunities actionable? |
| analysis-api-rate-limits | not recorded | Does the analysis cover client-facing behavior (status codes, headers), not only server protection? / Are the trade-offs balanced rather than one-sided? |
| code-chunk-array | not recorded | Does the function behave correctly for empty arrays, size larger than the array, and non-integer sizes? / Is the code idiomatic and easy to read? |
| code-fix-off-by-one | not recorded | Is the explanation of the root cause correct and understandable? / Is the change minimal, with no unrelated rewrites? |
| plan-research-then-summary | not recorded | Is the plan description a fair one-line summary of the approach? / Would the subtask inputs give each agent enough context to do its part? |
| plan-code-tight-budget | not recorded | Does the plan avoid wasting a tight budget on steps the task does not need? / Is the code agent's input specific enough to get a usable function back? |
| plan-analysis-full-budget | not recorded | Does the order of steps make sense for a risk assessment? / Is the chosen mix a sensible use of the available budget? |
